# HANDOFF

## Current Status
Packet generated by Relay.

## Completed Phases
- Packet construction

## Known Issues
- Model-specific enrichment is provider-dependent.

## Next Agent Notes
Use only approved workspace tools.

# DECISIONS

## Confirmed

- Authority remains in the Relay policy layer.

## Open

- Provider-specific enrichment remains open.

## Log

- Packet created before execution.

# REVIEW CHECKLIST

- [ ] Verify changed files
- [ ] Run acceptance tests
- [ ] Confirm no secrets

# Start

Follow the mission packet and stop at policy boundaries.

# Review

Review the evidence and report failures.

# Discovery

## Goal
Identify repository and immutable starting state.

## Scope
Repository metadata and approved context.

## Out of scope
Unapproved writes or credential access.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Starting commit is recorded.
- [ ] Repository scope is recorded.

# Plan

## Goal
Break work into bounded steps.

## Scope
Mission acceptance criteria.

## Out of scope
Open-ended optimization.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Steps have owners.
- [ ] Stop conditions are explicit.

# Implementation

## Goal
Apply only approved actions.

## Scope
The isolated workspace.

## Out of scope
Destructive or publishing operations.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each action passes policy.
- [ ] The diff is captured.

# Review

## Goal
Inspect the diff independently.

## Scope
Changed files and tests.

## Out of scope
Self-approval of high-risk actions.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Reviewer records an outcome.
- [ ] Unsafe changes are rejected.

# Verification

## Goal
Run deterministic checks.

## Scope
Acceptance and regression checks.

## Out of scope
Treating model claims as evidence.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Eval results are persisted.
- [ ] Failed checks affect status.

# Handoff

## Goal
Preserve artifacts, events, and next steps.

## Scope
Run evidence and resumable state.

## Out of scope
Silent packet mutation after execution.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Run state can be resumed.
- [ ] A machine-readable report exists.
